name: db-setup-cli
description: TUI CLI for PostgreSQL and Typesense management using React and Ink

scripts.build:bin: pnpm run build:bundle && mkdir -p bin && bun build dist/bundle.mjs --compile --external react-devtools-core --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile=bin/db-setup-darwin-arm64 && bun build dist/bundle.mjs --compile --external react-devtools-core --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile=bin/db-setup-darwin-x64 && bun build dist/bundle.mjs --compile --external react-devtools-core --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile=bin/db-setup-linux-arm64 && bun build dist/bundle.mjs --compile --external react-devtools-core --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile=bin/db-setup-linux-x64 && bun build dist/bundle.mjs --compile --external react-devtools-core --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile=bin/db-setup-windows-x64.exe
